stick.what: HV rectifier stick, 2CL77 class (20 kV, 5 mA, avalanche)

clamp.what: the clamp string: 66 x 1.5KE200A in a meander, its HV and REF ends at opposite ends

clamp_half.what: half the clamp string: 33 x 1.5KE200A in a meander

inputs.rules: sim/multiplier_layout.py deck_check, clearance; sim/parts_first_cut.py E_POT 2.0 kV/mm, CLR_MARGIN 1.5

stack.note: the redesign's column sat 39 mm from the deck's parts (sim/multiplier-layout-3d-findings.md); each side's stack beyond the deck moves in by dh

bracket.material: PTFE (material group I, CTI >= 600; sim/parts_first_cut.py MATERIALS)
bracket.seats: two U-seats, 3 mm wire, the wire bonded or tied in [IR]
bracket.balance: an identical arm at angle + 180 deg (no wires): the pair balances [OC]

load.note: the wires' centrifugal load at the seats; the arm's own load into the can's face
